ruleName: Taking Relief from Abnormal Course Conditions
group: Taking Relief from Abnormal Course Conditions
title: No Play Zones in Relief Situations
question: If your ball, stance or swing is in a no play zone, what must you do?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies and ignore the no play zone.
Take free relief; you are not allowed to play the ball as it lies.
Take a penalty stroke before moving the ball.
Ask your group for permission to play from there.

explanation: You must take free relief if your ball, stance or swing is in a no play zone. Playing from there is not allowed under the rules.
